derivation.note: crit_free_gb=50 sits just under the 54.5 GB of measured demand because a breach is a signal to reclaim, not a cliff: the guard must fire while there is still room to run the GC that clears it. warn_free_gb=100 gives roughly one GC cycle of lead time. Percent-used is deliberately NOT a halt criterion -- on a 3.6 TiB volume the ten points between 90% and 100% are 360 GB, two orders of magnitude more than any single lane needs.
